opening.argument: The speaker describes preparing for NEET-PG while working and caring for her daughter, using Marrow lectures and practice tests. She says she downloaded a paid version and prepared one or two lectures a day, presenting the service as part of an interview-style educational testimonial. The description does invite viewers to fill out a form for a callback about unspecified offers. But the available evidence does not identify what information the form requests, the offer conditions, any payment requirement, or what happens at the link. On this record, the paid study service and its promotion are consistent with ordinary education commerce, not an established scam.

citations.quote: Towards the end of March, I finally downloaded the paid version of Marrow and I started preparing maybe 1 or 2 lectures in a day
I always used to take the grant test whenever it went on.
For great offers, fill up this form and you will get a call back from a Marrow representative. http://bit.ly/Marrowoffers
